description.en: A liquid droplet pulls out of a round button and unfolds into a tilted menu, then snaps back into the button.
description.zh: 液滴从圆钮中拉出，翻展成带透视的菜单，收起时快速吸回圆钮。

keywords: 液滴 吸附 展开 菜单 翻转 透视 油画 玻璃 圆钮 genie liquid pull out menu gooey SVG 3D perspective imharshin

useCases: 圆钮展开四项快捷菜单
A liquid button reveals a perspective action menu
discovery.caveat: 菜单项只显示本地提示，可通过 onAction 接入应用。原背景画作的再分发许可尚未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML and artwork adapted to a shared instance-scoped DOM/SVG core with six native framework entries.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Click the round button to open the menu. Choose an action, click outside or press Escape to close. Switch to 0.3× to inspect the motion.
instructions.zh: 点击圆钮展开菜单。选择操作、点击外部或按 Esc 收起，可切换至 0.3× 慢速观察动效。
